title: Bill introduced
body: A member of Congress introduces a bill in the House or Senate.

title: Committee
body: The bill is referred to a committee for study, hearings, and markup.

title: Floor vote
body: If released from committee, each chamber votes on the bill.

title: Other chamber
body: The bill goes to the other chamber. Differences are reconciled in conference if needed.

title: President
body: The President signs the bill into law or vetoes it. Congress may override a veto with a two-thirds vote.

title: Law
body: A signed bill becomes a public law and is assigned a number.
